annotations.title: Price of one tool in rupees

description: The price of one software tool from the productgrowth.in directory. The answer first says whether the price is verified (read on the vendor's own pricing page on a stated day) or unverified. Then: cheapest listed paid price in ₹ and how we got it (vendor lists rupees, or converted from dollars at the stated rate), whether it has a free plan, the date the price was checked, the vendor's pricing page, India fit, its score and recent price or plan changes. Read-only. Works with no key: a short answer that says first whether the price is verified or unverified. With the free "Key for AI agents" (pgai_…) from https://productgrowth.in/account/?from=mcp it adds plans, the rupee price we checked and India fit (100 calls a day).

slug.description: The tool's slug as productgrowth.in uses it (for example "hubspot", "zoho-crm"), or its name.
